generations.text: Sofia Petrov contacted support because the Aero 2 loses pairing every night since 2026-04-24. It is a Low priority case and the status is currently New. The agent offered a credit of $120.00. The customer confirmed order ORD-91573 and asked for a cancellation. The knowledge base notes that Aero 2 firmware 3.2 fixes the charging fault on the dock.
